entities.summary: Krzysztof Pomian, is a Polish philosopher, historian and essayist, born in Warsaw. He is a professor of history at the Uniwersytet Mikołaja Kopernika in Toruń and, in 2001, was academic director of the Museum of Europe in Brussels.
